forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: Mark a runCode call that calls no tools.* verb as a no-op
+---
+## Problem
+
+SWE-bench run no-otel-1011 (2026-10-11, Multitool a00e883), django__django-13964: while a `tools.code_context.detectProjects` call was pending, the model made 73 no-op runCode calls (`return "waiting placeholder"`, `return null`, `return "end 11"`, `"done 12"`, ...). Only the Router repetition watch stopped it. This is the same loop as task ^cf57dtd. See also ^1dzf1za (the shared pending text).
+
+## Work
+
+When a runCode snippet calls no `tools.*` verb, mark the call (for example in the tool result or in the operation event). The Router session must be able to see that the call does no work.
+
+The Router session (foundationmodelsrouter-17) gets a task that uses this mark: while work is pending, a no-op call stops the generation, the session does not run or answer it, and it waits for the injected result.
+
+Agree the form of the mark with the Router session before you write the code.
+
+## Constraints (decision of the user)
+
+- There are no turns and there is no wait tool.
+- Parallel tool calls must stay free.
+- The mark only gives information. It does not block or change a call.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- [ ] The form of the mark is agreed with foundationmodelsrouter-17.
+- [ ] A runCode call that calls no `tools.*` verb has the mark.
+- [ ] A runCode call that calls one or more `tools.*` verbs does not have the mark.
+- [ ] Tests cover the two cases. #bug
\ No newline at end of file
